from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,time,json,sys,hashlib
root=Path('/home/andrew-peterson/.codex/worktrees/stdlib-foundation/laniusc')
p=root/'tests/fixtures/stdlib_compiler_state/parameter-scoped-graphs'
changed=json.loads((p/'changed-shaders.json').read_text()); i=int(sys.argv[1]);name=changed[i]
folder=p/'warmup';folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
shader=root/'target/stdlib-perf/results/current-shaders'/name
cmd=[str(root/'target/stdlib-perf/build/release/shader_pipeline_probe'),str(shader),str(shader.with_suffix('.reflect.json'))]
start=time.monotonic()
with (folder/f'{i:02}.log').open('w') as f:
 try: code=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=90).returncode
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired: code=124
r={'index':i,'shader':name,'exit_code':code,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(shader.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(folder/f'{i:02}.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r),flush=True);sys.exit(code)
